shared_elements: incised circular ring or disc motif
justification: The strongest correspondence is the same schematic incised vocabulary on a rounded anthropomorphic body: cup-like depressions and circular ring motifs set among curving, serpentine lines. The biggest difference is that A shows the whole figure with head, arms, chest bands, and lower body, while B shows only a cropped area of the decorated upper body, so many of A’s elements and the full vertical arrangement are not visible in B.
